# k3d_cluster (Resource)

A k3d cluster. Changing anything except `ports` and `timeout` replaces the cluster. `volumes`, `k3s_args`, `node_labels`, `runtime_labels`, `env`, `host_aliases`, `registries`, `subnet`, and `traefik` cannot be read back from k3d, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. Import a cluster by name. After an import, those settings are adopted from your configuration instead of replacing the cluster, but `ports` are read from the cluster, so declare the existing ones or the next apply removes them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "k3d_cluster" "main" {
  name    = "demo"
  image   = "rancher/k3s:v1.32.4-k3s1"
  servers = 3
  agents  = 2
  traefik = false

  api = {
    port = 6445
  }

  ports = [
    { host_port = 8080, container_port = 30080 },
  ]

  volumes = [
    { source = "/data/k3d", destination = "/var/lib/rancher/k3s/storage" },
  ]

  k3s_args = [
    { arg = "--tls-san=k3d.example.com", node_filters = ["server:*"] },
  ]

  node_labels = [
    { key = "tier", value = "worker", node_filters = ["agent:*"] },
  ]

  registries = {
    use = [k3d_registry.cache.ref]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) k3s image with a pinned tag or digest, such as `rancher/k3s:v1.32.4-k3s1`.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.

### Optional

- `agents` (Number) Number of agent nodes.
- `api` (Attributes) How the Kubernetes API is exposed. On a remote Docker host, set `port`, because the default free port is chosen on the machine running Terraform, and set `host`, because the default `0.0.0.0` is only reachable locally. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api))
- `env` (Attributes Set) Environment variables for the node containers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--env))
- `host_aliases` (Attributes List) Entries added to `/etc/hosts` in the nodes and to CoreDNS. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--host_aliases))
- `k3s_args` (Attributes List) Extra arguments for k3s. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--k3s_args))
- `network` (String) Existing Docker network to join. Defaults to a new `k3d-<name>` network. The `host` network is not supported.
- `node_labels` (Attributes Set) Kubernetes labels for the nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_labels))
- `ports` (Attributes Set) Host ports mapped through the cluster load balancer. Changed in place, with a brief interruption while k3d replaces the load balancer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))
- `registries` (Attributes) Container registries for the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--registries))
- `runtime_labels` (Attributes Set) Docker labels for the node containers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runtime_labels))
- `servers` (Number) Number of server nodes. Use an odd number: an even number of etcd members adds no fault tolerance.
- `subnet` (String) Subnet for the cluster network, such as `172.28.0.0/16`.
- `timeout` (String) How long to wait for creation, including image pulls. Defaults to `10m`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Cluster join token. Generated when not set.
- `traefik` (Boolean) Whether k3s installs its bundled Traefik ingress controller.
- `volumes` (Attributes Set) Volumes mounted into the nodes. `source` is a path on the Docker host or a named volume, and is not removed when the cluster is destroyed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))

### Read-Only

- `client_certificate` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded client certificate.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded client key.
- `cluster_ca_certificate` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded cluster CA certificate.
- `host` (String) Kubernetes API URL.
- `id` (String) The cluster name.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig for the cluster. Holds an admin client key, so use an encrypted state backend.

### Nested Schema for `api`

Optional:

- `host` (String) Host name used in the kubeconfig.
- `host_ip` (String) Host IP the API listens on.
- `port` (Number) Host port the API listens on.


<a id="nestedatt--env"></a>
### Nested Schema for `env`

Required:

- `name` (String) Variable name.
- `value` (String) Variable value.

Optional:

- `node_filters` (List of String) k3d node filters such as `server:*` or `agent:0`. Defaults to all servers and agents.


<a id="nestedatt--host_aliases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `host_aliases`

Required:

- `hostnames` (List of String) Host names for the IP address.
- `ip` (String) IP address.


<a id="nestedatt--k3s_args"></a>
### Nested Schema for `k3s_args`

Required:

- `arg` (String) Argument such as `--tls-san=example.com`.

Optional:

- `node_filters` (List of String) k3d node filters such as `server:*` or `agent:0`. Defaults to all servers and agents.


<a id="nestedatt--node_labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_labels`

Required:

- `key` (String) Label key.
- `value` (String) Label value.

Optional:

- `node_filters` (List of String) k3d node filters such as `server:*` or `agent:0`. Defaults to all servers and agents.


<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Required:

- `container_port` (Number) Port on the nodes, such as a NodePort.
- `host_port` (Number) Port on the Docker host.

Optional:

- `host_ip` (String) Host IP to bind. Defaults to all interfaces.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp` or `udp`. Defaults to `tcp`.


<a id="nestedatt--registries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `registries`

Optional:

- `config` (String, Sensitive) Contents of k3s `registries.yaml`, not a file path. Use `file()` to load one.
- `use` (List of String) Registries to connect, usually `k3d_registry.<name>.ref`.


<a id="nestedatt--runtime_labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runtime_labels`

Required:

- `key` (String) Label key.
- `value` (String) Label value.

Optional:

- `node_filters` (List of String) k3d node filters such as `server:*` or `agent:0`. Defaults to all servers and agents.


<a id="nestedatt--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volumes`

Required:

- `destination` (String) Path inside the node. May end in `:ro`.
- `source` (String) Path on the Docker host or volume name.

Optional:

- `node_filters` (List of String) k3d node filters such as `server:*` or `agent:0`. Defaults to all servers and agents.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import k3d_cluster.main demo
```
